chosen_titles.rationale: Title 2.2 Administration of Government — houses Chapter 4.4 (Lobbyists), the Virginia lobbying-disclosure regime administered by the Virginia Conflict of Interest and Ethics Advisory Council.

notes: VA 2025 vintage live on Justia (no Cloudflare block at pass-1, unlike VA 2015). Title 2.2 selected; other candidate titles ruled out: Title 24.2 (Elections) covers campaign finance not lobbying; Title 30 (General Assembly) is legislative procedure not disclosure; Title 18.2 (Crimes) and Title 19.2 (Criminal Procedure) are out of scope.
